## About
Hi, I'm Alex Davis, better known as Alex The Car Doctor. I fix cars on Joy Lake Rd in Morrow, Georgia. Growing up, I loved anything and everything auto, and my Hot Wheels collection was my pride and joy. I still can't picture doing anything else.
I started out as a Subaru repair technician, and Subaru is still my forte, but I work on cars of all shapes and sizes. I've worked at shops including Midas and Goodyear and was a mechanic for U-Haul and UPS. I hold an Automotive Technology degree from Atlanta Technical College, several ASE certifications, and I'm an Under Car Specialist.
I'm honest and I don't beat about the bush. You'll know what's wrong, what your choices are, and exactly what you're paying for. When I'm not under a car, I'm home in Decatur with my wife and kids.

## Services
- Testing to pinpoint the issue: Banging, clanging, or won't start? We use the right testing equipment to find what's actually going on.
- Objective repair advice: Honest advice on how to fix your car, so you can decide what makes sense for you.
- Parts and labor warranty: We source quality parts for your car and stand behind the work with a 2 year parts and labor warranty with nationwide coverage.
- Oil change: Routine oil changes from the same team that handles the big jobs.
- Financing: Financing options to help cover the cost of parts and labor.
- Local towing: Broken down nearby? Our network of towing companies can get your car to the shop from around Morrow.

## FAQ
Q: How do I book an appointment?
A: The quickest way is to call Alex at 470-435-0015. You can also send details through the contact form and we'll call you back to set up a time.

Q: Do you only work on Subaru cars?
A: Subaru is Alex's specialty, but the shop works on cars of all shapes and sizes.

Q: Can I pay for a big repair over time?
A: We offer financing options to help cover the cost of parts and labor. Ask us about them when you call.
